coordinate_convention: Each transform maps child-frame coordinates into parent-frame coordinates; meters and right-handed rotations for URDF, millimeters in CAD source/export.

parameter_semantics.length_delta_mm: Modify only the straight support-rod segment along its measured longitudinal axis; retain the wrist mount geometry and translate the distal plate pivot accordingly.
parameter_semantics.camera_plate_tilt_delta_deg: Rotate only the camera connection plate around its identified rod-to-plate pivot and hinge axis; do not rotate the whole bracket or wrist.
parameter_semantics.zero_parameters_requirement: length_delta_mm=0 and camera_plate_tilt_delta_deg=0 must reconstruct the actual source geometry within stated BRep numerical tolerance.

input_gate: Do not generate or label proxy geometry as the supplied camera-bracket STEP. Populate this schema only from readable BRep and explicit component identification.
